templates.name: longcat_avatar15_talk

templates.note: Use a picture of an invented person or someone who agreed, and a voice that is theirs or made from a description. One 93-frame window; longer audio needs the extend loop. 24 of 48 blocks swap to RAM to keep VRAM near 21 GiB.

templates.name: hymotion_t2m_preview
templates.title: HY-Motion 1.0: Words to Motion
templates.desc: Tencent's HY-Motion 1.0 DiT turns a sentence into a body motion (Qwen3-8B and CLIP-L read the words), previewed as a skeleton clip that follows the body, through Aero-Ex's HY-Motion nodes.
templates.source: Studio template; Aero-Ex/ComfyUI-HyMotion as the hardened copy (official download URLs, no remote code, a ComfyUI v0.43 weight fix)
templates.note: The pack loads Qwen3-8B from one file: join the repo's five bf16 shards into one (no tensor changes). The text encoder runs on the CPU here to keep VRAM low. The sampler also needs Tencent's wooden mannequin data (assets/dump_wooden from Tencent-Hunyuan/HY-Motion-1.0). Tencent Hunyuan licence: not the EU, UK or South Korea.

templates.name: kolors_t2i
templates.title: Kolors: Text to Image
templates.desc: Kwai's Kolors (SDXL-style UNet with a ChatGLM3 text encoder) through kijai's KwaiKolorsWrapper, 25 steps at cfg 5, decoded by core VAEDecode with Kolors' own VAE.
templates.source: Studio template; kijai/ComfyUI-KwaiKolorsWrapper (Apache-2.0) as the hardened copy with two transformers-5 fixes (nodepack_library/patched)
templates.note: The pack reads models/diffusers/Kolors as the whole diffusers repo, including the ChatGLM3 text_encoder (7 .bin shards, 12.5 GB, Kwai-Kolors/Kolors text_encoder/). Kolors model licence: over 100 million monthly users, or a cloud platform, needs a licence from Kuaishou.

templates.name: face_gfpgan_restore
templates.title: GFPGAN 1.4: Restore a Face
templates.desc: comfyorg's GFPGAN node: facexlib finds and parses the face, GFPGAN 1.4 redraws it and pastes it back. Faces only; the rest of the picture is left as it was.
templates.source: Studio template; comfyorg/comfyui_gfpgan (Apache-2.0, Pack Lab shortlist, loaded ok in the sandbox)
templates.note: Use it on generated faces or with the person's consent. It redraws a face rather than recovering it: from a very small face it can change who it looks like.

templates.name: hunyuanworld_pano_t2i

templates.note: ComfyUI's sampler has no circular padding, which HunyuanWorld's own pipeline adds, so a faint line can show where the panorama wraps. FLUX.1-dev is non-commercial; the LoRA is under Tencent's HunyuanWorld licence (not the EU, UK or South Korea).

templates.name: klein9b_character_scene
templates.title: Character swap: FLUX.2 Klein 9B, character + outfit + place
templates.desc: Three reference pictures: a character, an outfit and a place. Klein 9B puts that character, wearing that outfit, into that place, 4 steps, CFG 1. Ported from the tested three-reference graph (the plain arm: the KV-cache arm changed the face).
templates.source: Studio template from the saved three-reference Klein graph (character, outfit, room)
templates.note: Use invented people or people who agreed. Proof on this box: an invented painter, a rust field jacket and an empty greenhouse, 17.5 s, 28.6 GiB peak; the face and build held, the jacket's pockets and collar carried over. Flaws seen: the hair came out lighter and wavier in the warm light, a slight smile was added, the character's own trousers and shoes stay (only the named garment changes), and the output is square at 1 MP.

templates.name: qwen21_outfit_turbo
templates.title: Outfit swap: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo, 8 steps
templates.desc: A person and a garment to that person wearing it, fast: the Outfit Swap LoRA at strength 1 on the Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo transformer, the tuned 8-step sigma list, CFG 1. The 25-step try-on template is the slower, higher-effort version.
templates.source: Comfy Copilot graph qwen21_outfit_turbo, with the Turbo transformer in place of the Turbo LoRA (the LoRA is not on this box)
templates.note: The LoRA's licence is rent-only on its source; read it before commercial use.

templates.name: krea2_identity_swap
templates.title: Character swap: Krea 2 Identity Edit, person into a scene
templates.desc: A scene with a person and a character picture: the person in the scene becomes the character, in the same place, pose and light. Krea 2 Turbo with the Krea 2 Identity Edit v1.2 LoRA (rank 128), 10 steps, CFG 1, the character weighted 3 to the scene's 1.
templates.source: Studio template from the comfyui-mcp krea2-identity-edit pack (its outfit layout turned into a person swap, as the LoRA's card describes); nodes from lbouaraba/comfyui-krea2edit (Apache-2.0) on the Krea2 instance
templates.note: Unofficial community fine-tune of Krea 2 Raw by Lars Bouaraba; Krea 2 Community License; not affiliated with Krea. Use v1.2 (the V2 files add a non-commercial licence). Invented people only: the licence bans deceptive pictures of real people. Runs on the Krea2 instance, which loads the comfyui-krea2edit nodes. Proof on this box: an invented man at a rainy tram shelter swapped for an invented lifeguard, 36.9 s, 36.9 GiB peak; the street, shelter, shop window and light held, and the face matches the character. Flaws seen: the character's own arms-out pose and bare feet came along instead of the replaced man's stance (a whole-person swap, as the LoRA card warns), and the camera sits a little closer than in the scene.
